name: jinpei-skills
description: Li Jinpei's personal agent skills, shared across Claude Code, Codex and pi.

plugins.name: working-on-llvm
plugins.description: Workflow and conventions for fixing upstream llvm/llvm-project (LLVM/MLIR/Clang) issues and getting PRs merged.

plugins.name: amdgpu-isa
plugins.description: AMD GPU ISA reference for CDNA 1-5 and RDNA 1-4: instruction encodings, operands, gfx mappings, aliases and cross-generation diffs from AMD's MIT-licensed machine-readable ISA XML.

plugins.name: amdgpu-isa-builder
plugins.description: Builds the AMD ISA manual pages locally for amdgpu-isa and regenerates its corpus. Ships the builder, not the corpus.

plugins.name: writing-python-docstrings-and-comments
plugins.description: Python docstring and comment conventions from PEP 257 and the Google Python Style Guide.

plugins.name: locking-gpus
plugins.description: Run GPU jobs under a per-GPU flock so concurrent benchmarks on a shared machine never share a GPU.

plugins.name: capture-att-trace
plugins.description: Capture rocprofv3 ATT thread traces of a GPU kernel into versioned, indexed capture directories.
